g.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 12b: What the XGBoost models used, CAMS clearness index'

text.font-family: Matter XH, DM Sans, sans-serif

g.text: Figure 12b: What the XGBoost models used, CAMS clearness index

g.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Six NGED solar farms, daylight hours, September 2019 to June 2026. ERA5: ECMWF's reanalysis of past weather. CAMS: satellite irradiance service. Each XGBoost model was refitted on different blocks of months and with different random starts. Dot: mean over the refits. Line: their range. clearness_index: ERA5 solar radiation divided by the sun's top-of-atmosphere flux (an input, not the CAMS target). Dashed rule, first panel: the largest shuffled copy's share (0.2%). Share of total gain: how much of the model's fit a column accounts for. Shuffled copies are the same columns shuffled across hours, so they show the share that noise alone earns. Gain is measured on the training data and splits credit between correlated columns. Descriptive only: the planned contrasts decide whether a variable helps.'

text.font-family: Matter XH, DM Sans, sans-serif
